note: The Keeper's lines for the reel. 'take' is an existing in-game recording in src/voice/raw/ (ElevenLabs, voice 'Arkadius - Old Storyteller', eleven_v4, made for beta 9); 'words' picks the phrase by word index in that take's Whisper transcript (wordtimes.json). Nothing is re-timed: build_vo.py cuts each phrase at the quietest point of the pauses around it.

lines.text: Once, the world had one sun
He drank the last of the light himself, and the sky went black.
Nothing that dies here stays dead. It comes back wrong.
But you came back with a spark still in you.
You're not strong yet, so don't be there when it lands.
Something is wearing your face, and it is holding your light.
Relight the world, one shrine and one Sovereign at a time.
